title: Cantonese Roast Prawns
description: A Cantonese-inspired dish featuring succulent prawns roasted to perfection with a sweet and savory glaze.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together Roast Vegetables Sauce, Tender Honey, and 1 tsp sesame oil.
Add sliced ginger and minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
Place the prawns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the prawns with the sauce mixture, making sure they're evenly coated.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tbsp of sesame oil over the prawns.
Roast in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes or until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
